desc: Parse input: read H, W and H row strings; convert each row to an integer mask, build count array cnt of size 2^W (list of ints).
Build g array: g[q] = min(popcount(q), W − popcount(q)) using int.bit_count().
Implement iterative in-place FWHT (XOR butterfly u,v → u+v, u−v); apply forward transform to cnt and g (optionally fused in one stage loop for speed).
Pointwise multiply transforms, inverse FWHT, divide by 2^W to get conv[c] = sum_p cnt[p]*g(p^c).

Clean up the FWHT solution: remove dead code and the float-based rounding, keep exact integer division (v // N since convolution values are non-negative), then verify correctness against samples 1–3 (expect 2, 0, 13) and edge cases (W=1, H=1, all-identical rows).
